expression: /* Audio: Japanese, Korean, Chinese or Mandarin */ negate(merge(language(streams, 'Japanese'), language(streams, 'Korean'), language(streams, 'Chinese'), language(streams, 'Mandarin')), streams)
/* Subtitles: English or German required */ negate(merge(subtitle(streams, 'English'), subtitle(streams, 'German')), streams)
/* Exclude AV1 (unsupported by clients) */ negate(encode(streams, 'AV1'), streams)
/* 720p only when fewer than 5 x 1080p */ count(resolution(streams, '1080p')) >= 5 ? resolution(streams, '720p') : []
